Market today: The mood is skittish, with French unrest and debt fears adding to existing worries about borrowing costs. This is hitting broader markets and especially impacting sentiment for growth-oriented names.

Your holdings: CRWD is down 30%, SMCI down 28%, SOXL down 58%, and SPAL down 37%. These leveraged and tech names are feeling the heat. MUU is down 35% and SNOW down 8%. QQQ and QQQI are also in the red.

Watch: Keep an eye on the tech sector's reaction to the crucial week ahead and any further developments from the French situation.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your highly concentrated, leveraged tech book through this choppy environment.
plays: TRIM QQQ: Stop is 670. Consider trimming if it breaks below.
TRIM SMH: Stop is 540. Watch this closely.
HOLD METU: Stop is 18.3. This leveraged ETF is holding up relatively well.
